description: Source code for the mac_dl_processor class, implementing downlink processing in a MAC layer, including cell management and UE bearer operations.

classes.name: mac_dl_processor
classes.description: Handles downlink MAC processing, including cell and UE management.

methods.name: has_cell
methods.description: Checks if a cell with given index exists.

methods.name: add_cell
methods.description: Creates and adds a new MAC cell.

methods.name: remove_cell
methods.description: Removes a MAC cell by index.

methods.name: add_ue
methods.description: Adds a UE to a specified cell asynchronously.

methods.name: remove_ue
methods.description: Removes a UE from a specified cell asynchronously.

methods.name: addmod_bearers
methods.description: Adds or modifies bearers for a UE in a cell asynchronously.

methods.name: remove_bearers
methods.description: Removes bearers for a UE in a cell asynchronously.
